value.rationale: The initiating Davies thermometry benchmark fixes a ground reset target. An exact controllable threshold at reset-to-bath ratio 1/3 tells when energy-basis coherence is required for the best high-temperature stationary thermometer, and its slope calibrates finite-temperature shift. An exact finite-temperature witness establishes a nonzero improvement over all energy-diagonal targets at the same reset rate, supplying a real operational capability distinction; scope and costs are clearly limited.
